name: CHEM 1122
title: Chemical Principles and Applications
description: Brief but comprehensive survey of important chemical theories and applications of chemistry. Preparation for one-semester courses in organic chemistry and biochemistry. Atomic structures, chemical bonding, chemical reactions, stoichiometry, states of matter, and theories of solutions. Does not fulfill the two-semester general chemistry requirement for majors in biology, chemistry, pharmacy, physics or agriculture, health and natural resources. Does not satisfy the admission requirements of medical and dental schools. CA 3-LAB.
requirement_description: Not open to students who have passed CHEM 1124. May not be taken out of sequence after passing CHEM 1127Q or 1137Q or 1147Q.
